subject: Consolidated SLA SKUs & escalation coverage — pricing request
messages:
From: Aisha Lee <aisha.lee@brightline.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Chu <evan.chu@brightline.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidated SLA SKUs & escalation coverage — pricing request

Priyom,

Thanks for the call earlier. Procurement asked me to follow up with a single consolidated SKU approach for premium support so we can simplify PO/invoicing. They want a price sheet with 2–3 SKU choices (basically: Business, Enterprise, Enterprise+ with 24/7 escalation). Can you provide pricing and a quick note about what falls under each SKU (uptime tier, P1/P2 response SLA, on-call escalation band, credits)?

Key constraints from our CFO: prefer fixed monthly retainer rather than purely usage-based for support; target year-1 spend is $600k. They also asked whether we can ladder discounts if we commit to a multi-region deployment (US + EU) and to a 12-month renewal.

Attached is the SLA_SKU_grid we've been using internally — we want a consolidated starting point we can present to legal and procurement.

Appreciate a quick turnaround here, ideally EOD Tue (11/9).

Best,
Aisha
Purchasing Lead, Brightline

Attachments: Brightline_SLA_SKU_grid.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Lee <aisha.lee@brightline.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated SLA SKUs & escalation coverage — pricing request

Aisha — thanks, looping in Karthik (pricing) and Vanessa (enterprise ops) to get you a consolidated sheet and narrative. Preliminary proposal below so you can see the shape; we'll formalize in the attached draft addendum and SKU grid.

High-level SKUs (provisional pricing, USD):
- Business SLA (SLA-B): $12,000 / month retainer — 99.9% uptime, P1 response within 4 hours (business hours M-F), P2 within 24 hours, no 24/7 escalation. 5% discount if annual prepay.
- Enterprise SLA (SLA-E): $25,000 / month retainer — 99.95% uptime, P1 response 1 hour (24/7 on-call), P2 response 4 hours, includes 10 escalation credits / month for on-site-runbook assist (virtual). 8% discount at $500k annual commit.
- Enterprise+ (SLA-E+): $40,000 / month retainer — 99.99% uptime, P1 response 30 minutes (24/7), P2 response 2 hours, dedicated escalation desk + quarterly review with a named TAM. 15% discount at $1M+ ARR commit.

Additional notes:
- Uptime credits: credits scale with outage severity; example matrix included in grid.
- Multi-region deployment (US+EU) qualifies for an additional 3% discount on retainer if committed for 12 months.
- We can offer a one-time implementation credit of $10k (to offset onboarding runbook work) for any Enterprise-level commitment signed by 12/31/2027.

Karthik / Vanessa — can you confirm whether we can push to an 18% max concession for strategic customers and whether the 3% multi-region stacking is acceptable to finance? Aisha — we'll send the formal SKU grid and addendum by EOD Tue.

Thanks,
Priyom
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Draft_Support_Addendum_v3.pdf (draft)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Aisha Lee <aisha.lee@brightline.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated SLA SKUs & escalation coverage — pricing request

Priyom / team — reviewed the provisional SKUs. A few internal constraints to flag before we finalize:

1) Max standard concession: Finance will approve up to 12% discount in pricing tool without executive sign-off; anything beyond that needs a Deal Desk entry and manager approval. For strategic logo plays we can go to 18% with Director approval and additional commercial offsets (shorter SLAs for trial, committed annual payment).

2) Escalation credits are consumable at 2 hours each; beyond included credits we bill at $350 / hour for escalation engineering time (blended). We'd prefer to keep the dedicated TAM only on Enterprise+ to limit named resource commitments.

3) For multi-region stacking, finance is comfortable with a single 3% stack if the customer signs a multi-region addendum; we should avoid sliding additive stacks for other promos.

I'll update the grid: add a deal-level concession flag and a column for "requires Deal Desk". Priyom — recommend we offer Brightline the Enterprise SKU at 10% off (vs list Enterprise price) if they sign a 12-month prepay at $500k ARR; that keeps us inside standard approval. If they push for Enterprise+, we'll need Deal Desk for >12% concession.

-Karthik
Director, Commercial Operations
From: Aisha Lee <aisha.lee@brightline.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 10:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated SLA SKUs & escalation coverage — pricing request

Thanks for the clear options. A few follow-ups from procurement/cfo:

- Brightline prefers a single blended enterprise SKU if it simplifies our PO process — can you provide a "blended Enterprise" price that sits between SLA-E and SLA-E+ but includes a capped number of TAM hours per quarter (say 8 hrs/qtr)?
- Will the onboarding credit ($10k) be applied to the first invoice or as a credit memo after signing?
- Can you confirm whether the 24/7 on-call line for P1 is included in SLA-E or only for SLA-E+? Your note above suggests SLA-E has 24/7 on-call; procurement wants that explicitly in the addendum.

If you can get a single blended SKU number and a clean addendum that explicitly calls out the P1 contact method/phone escalation ladder, procurement can fast-track approval. We expect to review the formal addendum by EOD Wed.

-Aisha
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Lee <aisha.lee@brightline.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated SLA SKUs & escalation coverage — pricing request

Aisha — appreciate the quick feedback. Final answers below; attached is a single-page "Blended Enterprise" SKU snapshot we will hand to procurement.

Blended Enterprise SKU (SLA-BE): $31,000 / month retainer (annual prepay or monthly billed with 12-month commitment). Includes:
- 99.96% uptime target
- P1 response within 45 minutes (24/7 phone + escalation desk)
- P2 response within 3 hours (24/7 triage)
- 8 TAM hours / quarter (virtual advisory & quarterly runbook review)
- 6 escalation credits / month (2-hour blocks)
- Onboarding credit: $10,000 applied as a credit on the first invoice following signature

Discounting & approvals:
- At $600k ARR (your stated year-1 target) we can extend 10% off the SLA-BE price, bringing it to $27,900 / month effective (Deal Desk NOT required).
- Multi-region (US+EU) addendum gives an extra 3% off; stackable with the ARR discount but not with promotional coupons.
- Anything > 15% total concession requires Director approval; > 18% needs VP approval.

Next steps (action items):
1) Vanessa: finalize the addendum language for the P1 phone ladder and escalation ownership (include SLAs for RTO on runbook activation).
2) Karthik: confirm the concession flag and create the Deal Desk record only if Brightline asks for >15% concession.
3) Aisha: confirm whether Brightline will do annual prepay or monthly billing with 12-month commitment. If prepay, we will apply the 10% ARR concession immediately.

If that looks ok we'll produce the two-page procurement packet (SKU snapshot + redlined addendum) and route to procurement.

Thanks,
Priyom
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Brightline_SLA_SKU_grid.xlsx, Draft_Support_Addendum_v3.pdf
